notes.title: Update and Demo for Prequel
notes.content:
Dear Owlish Gourmets,

the demo for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633510/Owl_Observatory/]Owl Observatory[/url], the prequel to Dinner with an Owl, is [b]out now![/b]
Experience a completely new adventure and dive deeper into the time-twisting mysteries of your owlish host.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633510/Owl_Observatory/][h3]Try the demo and add the game to your wishlist![/h3][/url]

[previewyoutube=0rWDOQpACa0;full][previewyoutube=0rWDOQpACa0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]


In addition to developing Owl Observatory, [b]Dinner with an Owl[/b] also received some love!
The newly [b]updated version[/b] includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] Added context-sensitive mouse cursors
[*] Items no longer stick to the cursor after use
[*] Adjusted the hotspot for Declan
[*] No more flickering in certain animations of Mr. Webb
[*] Some minor fixes
[/list]

[h3][b]Let's have Dinner![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Announcing Owl Observatory 🦉 🔭
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40104090/603bef837ff2ad6240a37b318d3b1b6e84b64fd0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40104090/1af247a7e39dc9dc1c91b3ee27270fda5b13a42e.png[/img][/url]

Friends of owlish dinners, I need your help: Please wishlist now and dive into a [b]surreal [/b]world of horror, comedy, delicious dinners and [b]time-twisting[/b] mysteries in [b]Owl Observatory[/b], the prequel to cult-favorite [b]Dinner with an Owl[/b].
[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633510/Owl_Observatory/]Wishlist Now![/url][/h2]

[h3]Story[/h3]
Enter the enigmatic mansion of Mr. Virgil Brooks, a peculiar [b]owlish[/b] gourmet who predicts the imminent end of time. 
Play as [b]Tycho Brahe[/b], the famed astronomer with the golden nose, and unravel the [b]dark secrets[/b] lurking within the mansion and its eccentric residents. 
[b]Time is slipping away — or is it?[/b]

[h3]Utilize your abilities wisely:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Travel through time[/b]
[*] [b]Clone yourself[/b] for devious deception
[*] [b]Hypnotize [/b]the vulnerable minds
[/list]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Immerse yourself with [b]full [/b]professional [b]voice acting[/b]
[*] Navigate a twisted, looping storyline
[*] Be captivated by an [b]eerie [/b]original [b]soundtrack[/b]
[*] Reconnect with familiar faces from [b]Dinner with an Owl[/b] and meet [b]new strange characters[/b]
[*] Enjoy about two hours of gameplay
[/list]

[b]Eternity begins now - at the Owl Observatory![/b] 
Are you ready for the unexpected?
